purpose: Image-reviewed historical parcel evidence from Internet Archive captures of earlier departmental bulletins. Never proof of actual or current farming. Sources hold decision-level area and scope; parcels hold one row per decision and printed reference.
normalization: Shared sections carry forward within a printed commune group; numbers are padded to four digits. Lettered sub-parcels and slash pairs keep reference null. Textual normalization only, not a verified crosswalk to current cadastral geometry.

dateRoles.documentDate: Signature date as printed; null when the printed date is impossible or incomplete.

sources.bulletin: Recueil spécial des actes administratifs n° 17/2012 du 16 mai 2012
sources.applicantRole: Requester of the aerial-spraying derogation (donneur d'ordre); not stated to be an owner or operator of any parcel

footnotes.(1): Only the parts of these parcels more than 50 m from the watercourse may be treated from the air.
footnotes.(2): Of the La Prêle parcels, totalling 0.86 ha, only an 8-are zone benefits from the derogation.

sources.note: Annex 1 lists parcels 'faisant l'objet de la demande de Soufflet Vigne pour lesquelles une dérogation est accordée'. Surfaces are printed per parcel without a unit; the 20.2443 total is read as hectares. The six Chablis Fyé La Prêle rows share one merged 0.08 cell and R 979 is printed twice; both are kept as printed. One Chichée-section row (C 1465) has a blank commune cell and stays unassigned. 'A2 555' is printed with section A2 and is not normalised. Chablis Fyé is an associated commune of Chablis (89068); the printed name is retained. A derogation records a treatment authorisation, not ownership, a lease or who farmed the parcel.

sources.note: PDF page numbers are cited; the printed folios are one lower (PDF page 128 is printed 127). Article 1 names Beine, Chablis, Chichée, Lignorelles and Maligny. Compared with 2012 the annex omits A 11 and A 23 (Les Preuses) and adds A 95 (Les Vaudésirs, 1.4641); YN 101 Côte de Vaubarousse is printed under Chablis, whereas 2012 printed it under Fontenay près de Chablis. The five La Prêle rows share one merged 0.08 cell. A derogation records a treatment authorisation, not ownership, a lease or who farmed the parcel.
